title: RadiationAggregated
description: Schema for geo/time windowed blobs on the radiation.aggregated Kafka topic. One record per geohash cell per event-time tumbling window, produced by the Flink GeoBucket aggregation.

geohash.description: Geohash of the aggregated cell (length equals precision).

precision.description: Geohash precision (characters) used to bucket events into this cell.

window_start.description: Inclusive start of the event-time tumbling window (based on captured_at).

window_end.description: Exclusive end of the event-time tumbling window.

count.description: Number of cleaned readings aggregated into this cell/window.

cpm_avg.description: Mean CPM across readings in the cell/window. Null if no non-null CPM readings.

cpm_max.description: Maximum CPM reading in the cell/window. Null if no non-null CPM readings.

cpm_min.description: Minimum CPM reading in the cell/window. Null if no non-null CPM readings.

class_counts.description: Count of readings per threshold classification within the cell/window.

worst_classification.description: Most severe classification seen in the cell/window (DANGER > WARN > SAFE). Null if no readings were classified.

centroid_latitude.description: Mean latitude of readings in the cell/window (cell centroid).

centroid_longitude.description: Mean longitude of readings in the cell/window (cell centroid).

rolling_cpm_avg.description: Smoothed mean cpm_avg over this window plus up to N prior event-time windows for this geohash cell (up to N+1 values; N = FLINK_ROLLING_WINDOWS, the prior-window baseline size). Null when this window carried no cpm_avg. Added by the Flink rolling-stats operator (M2). See docs/decisions/ADR-009.

cpm_zscore.description: Standard deviations this window's cpm_avg sits from the cell's recent baseline (prior windows only). Null when the baseline is too small (< 2 windows) or flat, or this window carried no cpm_avg.

anomaly.description: Whether |cpm_zscore| crossed the configured z-score threshold (FLINK_ZSCORE_THRESHOLD, default 3.0) — a statistical spike/dip for this cell. False when no z-score could be computed.
